description.value:
Speed +10 feet. After your attack, each target hit makes a Constitution save; failure reduces AC by 1 for 2 turns. At speed 50 feet or higher, reduce AC by 2 instead. No duplicate stacking.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
